"""Regression tests for boltons.strutils.ordinalize.

The bug: the teens check inspected the wrong tens digit, so teen
numbers got digit-based suffixes (11st, 12nd, 13rd) while numbers
ending in the twenties got ``th`` (21th, 22th, 23th).
"""
import unittest

from boltons.strutils import ordinalize


class OrdinalizeSuffixTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_single_digits(self):
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(0), '0th')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(1), '1st')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(2), '2nd')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(3), '3rd')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(4), '4th')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(9), '9th')

    def test_teens_are_th(self):
        for number in range(10, 20):
            self.assertEqual(ordinalize(number), '%dth' % number)
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(111), '111th')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(112), '112th')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(113), '113th')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(1010), '1010th')

    def test_twenties_use_last_digit(self):
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(20), '20th')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(21), '21st')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(22), '22nd')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(23), '23rd')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(24), '24th')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(29), '29th')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(121), '121st')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(122), '122nd')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(123), '123rd')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(1224), '1224th')

    def test_larger_numbers(self):
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(100), '100th')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(1515), '1515th')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(3694839230), '3694839230th')

    def test_negative_numbers(self):
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(-1), '-1st')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(-11), '-11th')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(-21), '-21st')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(-22), '-22nd')

    def test_string_numbers(self):
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize('1'), '1st')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize('11'), '11th')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize('22'), '22nd')

    def test_non_digit_string_unchanged(self):
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize('hi'), 'hi')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(''), '')


class OrdinalizeExtOnlyTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_suffix_only(self):
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(1, ext_only=True), 'st')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(2, ext_only=True), 'nd')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(3, ext_only=True), 'rd')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(4, ext_only=True), 'th')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(11, ext_only=True), 'th')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(12, ext_only=True), 'th')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(13, ext_only=True), 'th')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(21, ext_only=True), 'st')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(22, ext_only=True), 'nd')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize(23, ext_only=True), 'rd')

    def test_ext_only_leaves_non_digits_alone(self):
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize('hi', ext_only=True), '')
        self.assertEqual(ordinalize('', ext_only=True), '')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
